entries.title: No scrollbar in Settings
entries.detail: About specula now fits the window: the build facts stand in two columns, what each one means is in its tooltip, and Where your notes live has two short rows. Settings draws no scrollbar.

entries.title: Settings as big as tabula's; more in About
entries.detail: The Settings window has the size of tabula's. About specula lists the build code, build number, build date, the first commit, the web app and the Mac app, and says where your notes live. A new part, Account, shows who uses specula on this Mac and the vault it reads.

entries.title: A new icon: the eye
entries.detail: specula's app icon, menu bar icon, disk image and browser tab now show an eye: a lookout watching. The old mark was too fine at small sizes; the eye stays clear in the menu bar. Inside specula, the header and Settings › About keep the vault's mark.

entries.title: 3D opens behind the ship
entries.detail: Switched to 3D, the vault now turns to the view from behind the ship and a little above, as in the warp: ITAKB and ITKB at the top, ETH and kedavra in the middle, SRG SSR and NZZ at the bottom. The Timelapse keeps its own view.

entries.title: Other apps can open specula on a view
entries.detail: A link specula://show with a view of the vault brings the specula Mac app to the front on that view. GLaDOS uses it to show you the Cerebrum in specula, not in a browser tab.

entries.title: About and What's New in the family's style
entries.detail: About and What's New in the Mac app follow the folia style guide now, as Settings does: a head, a body of soft cards, and a foot with the buttons on the right. Done is the one amber button.

entries.title: A concept page uses its width, in the style guide's colours
entries.detail: A concept page's text now fills the page's column, as its tables do, and no table runs past it: a very wide one scrolls sideways inside the page. The colours follow folia's style guide: titles and headings in the text colour, amber only for links and what is selected, and every text easy to read in light and dark.

entries.title: The whole of specula follows the family's style guide
entries.detail: The header, the list, the concept page, the search bar and the card beside the map now use the sizes, weights and corners of folia's style guide, in the Mac's own font, as Settings does. The concept page's text is 14.5 px. The first row of categories stays on one line again in a 1440 px window, and hiding a knowledge base no longer moves the chips beside it.

entries.title: Settings and the windows follow the family's style guide
entries.detail: Settings, About, ⌘K and the Reports window now look as folia's style guide says: the Mac's own font, one base size, the small buttons of every Settings row 30 px high, and amber text and focus rings a little darker, so they read well on every light ground. The red Delete button reads well in dark mode too.

entries.title: Docs in Settings opens the manual in a window
entries.detail: In the specula Mac app, Settings › About specula › Docs opens the specula Field Manual in a window of the app, as the Docs button in the About specula window does. In a browser it still opens the page online.

entries.title: About specula has Settings…
entries.detail: About specula now has the buttons every app of the family has, in the same order: Docs, What's New… and Settings…, which opens specula's Settings the way the menu does.

entries.title: Docs opens the manual inside specula
entries.detail: About specula › Docs now shows the specula Field Manual in a window of specula's own, from the copy specula carries. It needs no claude.ai account and no internet, so anyone who has specula can read it. A link to the web in the manual opens in your browser.

entries.title: The window comes to the front at a start
entries.detail: Started again, specula now comes to the front with its window, instead of opening it behind the app you were in. Opened at login, it stays in the background.

entries.title: The Dock icon's menu holds the menu bar menu
entries.detail: A right click on specula's Dock icon shows the items of its menu bar icon: About, Settings…, Check for Updates…, Open specula and Open in Browser.

entries.title: ⌘H hides specula as in other apps
entries.detail: ⌘H hides specula with macOS's own Hide, as in scripta and unus. The hotkey brings it back.

entries.title: ⌘H gives the menu bar back
entries.detail: After ⌘H, the app behind specula comes to the front, with its name in the menu bar, as in other apps. Before, the menu bar still said specula.

entries.title: ⌘H hides specula; one look for the buttons
entries.detail: ⌘H hides the specula window, as in other apps. Every button in Settings and in specula's windows has one size and one type, and a link looks like the buttons beside it.

entries.title: Download specula for another Mac
entries.detail: Settings › Mac app in the app offers the newest build as a download too, for another Mac. The download opens in your browser.

entries.title: Settings › Mac app, tidied
entries.detail: Open at login is called "Start specula at login" now. The switch for update checks is gone: specula still checks once a day, and Check for Updates… is in the menus.

entries.title: Settings opens on General
entries.detail: The gear, ⌘, and Settings… in the menus open Settings on General.

entries.title: A hotkey for specula
entries.detail: ⌃⌥⌘S shows the specula window from any app; pressed again, it hides it. Settings › Mac app shows the hotkey and records new keys.

entries.title: Full screen in the Timelapse, in the app
entries.detail: The Timelapse's full-screen button works in the specula app too, not only in the browser.

entries.title: Warp speed at the end of the Timelapse
entries.detail: When the Timelapse has built the whole vault, the camera comes round behind it: the vault is the starship NCC-1701. Its nacelles glow, it draws out, and it goes to warp in a flash, the stars streaming past. Then the vault is back, at rest. With sound when you start the Timelapse yourself; not with reduced motion.

entries.title: Check for Updates in the specula menu again
entries.detail: The specula menu at the top left has Check for Updates… under Settings… again, as every app of the family has it: About specula, a line, Settings…, Check for Updates…, a line. In the menu of specula's icon, Settings… shows ⌘,.

entries.title: The icon's menu in murmur's order
entries.detail: The menu of specula's icon starts with About specula. Under a line follow Settings… and Check for Updates…, then Open specula and Open in Browser, then Show in Finder and Quit.

entries.title: The specula menu as in scripta
entries.detail: The specula menu at the top left starts with About specula, a line under it, then Settings…, as scripta's. Check for Updates… is in the menu of specula's icon.

entries.title: The vault's newest commit in About
entries.detail: About specula names the vault's newest commit as soon as it is made. Before, it said "uncommitted" until the next change to a concept.

entries.title: specula is the vault's viewer
entries.detail: The vault's old one-file viewer has retired. Open 00_Cerebrum opens specula, and while the app runs, this Mac's browser shows specula at 127.0.0.1:8760, where the old viewer was.

entries.title: Reports as in folia · The Brain's controls, one size
entries.detail: Reports as in folia: The Reports window and a report open in folia's window. A report reads like a page in folia, light or dark with specula, its drawings too; English and Deutsch sit at its foot. The Brain's controls, one size: In Settings › Brain, the Model and Effort menus and the buttons have one height, one width and one type. Every row has its icon.

entries.title: iCloud Drive's question, said
entries.detail: The first time, macOS asks whether specula may open files in iCloud Drive, where the vault is. specula now opens its window at once and says so while it waits, and shows the vault once you choose Allow.

entries.title: specula for Mac
entries.detail: specula comes as an app for your Mac. It starts specula's server, can open at login, shows in the menu bar or the Dock, and updates itself; while it runs, this Mac's browser shows specula at the same address.

entries.title: Light, dark or the system's and 3 more
entries.detail: Light, dark or the system's: Settings › General picks the look: light, dark, or the same as your Mac. Everything around the map follows it; the 2D map and the 3D view keep their dark sky. Settings as in folia: The gear opens Settings, the mark opens About: About specula, General, Knowledge bases, Brain, Keys and Mac app, in the same window as folia and j4k. What's new: Settings › About specula › What's new lists what changed in specula, newest first, and counts what you have not read yet. Commands with ⌘K: ⌘K finds a concept, a report, a view or a setting by its name, and opens it.

entries.title: Ask Claude and the reports in specula
entries.detail: Ask Claude, the reports and the Brain work in specula itself. A report opens inside specula, in English and German, and a link in it to a concept opens that concept.

entries.title: The vault in specula · Newer data with one click
entries.detail: The vault in specula: specula shows the vault as its old viewer did: the 2D map, the 3D view, the Timelapse, the concepts and the search, read live from the vault. Newer data with one click: When the vault changes, a note at the foot says so. Show brings the new state in and keeps your view, your search and your selection.
